review: Reuse installed QtWebEngine and the actual Tomimi public site. Exact level-ID/name registry selects canonical variant and emergency flag. Retained ToolPage holds the real browser profile and reading state. Failed parent qualification removes its active dependent page, including the branch where the parent did not remove its children itself. The registry stores public facts, not upstream program code. URLs contain only public topic/config/mode, zero relics and no local run fields. Visible text says difficulty/relics are set within the website. No new package or global graphics flags.
